scope: New primary-source specifications, newly photographed passenger U/Y/Z, and independently authored font candidates. This extends, rather than replaces, the existing BC die-grouping ledger.
method: Retrieved source-owner pages and official documents; inspected three original JPEGs, the ICBC identification guide, PDF image/font inventories, and the BC atlas and template in the creator's publicly downloadable BeamNG package. No pixel-fit score or exact contour validation was performed.

sources.title: Canadian License Plate Pack 1.2.1
sources.supports: Independent BC-specific raster recreation with visibly sweeping 6/9 and a bent 7, useful as a candidate comparator.
sources.licenceObservation: Creator expressly permits reuse of custom fonts with credit, both on the listing and in package metadata; this does not extend that statement to every background/logo asset.
limitations: A game-mod recreation, not manufacturer artwork or a physical specimen.
Raster atlases, not installable TTF/OTF/WOFF fonts.
Current template uses the older AB1-23C pattern and all 26 letters; do not reuse its grammar as official allocation evidence.
Template points to BeamNG's default font metrics, which are not included in this archive; this review inspected the atlas rather than claiming an independent exact game render.
Package metadata retains an older last_update field; the listing date and packed-by timestamp identify this downloaded version.

reusePolicyForThisReview: Original PDFs, photographs, commercial fonts and the BeamNG package are not committed. Sources, hashes and inspected observations are recorded; photographs remain with the source owner. No full-alphabet or current manufacturing-equivalence claim follows from this research.
